text.p: International Equity Resources Inc said Friday that the receipt of funds from the first block of stock sold to Kyoto Securities Ltd, due March 20, was delayed.
The company said it was advised by Kyoto that proceeds from the first block will be received in two $250,000 payments, the first to be sent the week of March 24 and the second the week of March 31.
In February, International Equity said it agreed to sell a total of 20 million shares of its common stock to Kyoto for $20 million. International Equity has 25 million shares outstanding.

International Equity said at the time that the first block of 500,000 shares must be purchased by March 20 and the second block of 4.5 million shares by June 30. The remaining three blocks of five million shares each must be purchased by December 31, 1997, June 30, 1998, and December 31, 1998.
